text:
leah: looping in policy + infra. we need a final decision on how long envelope values can be stored in hosted telemetry and what level of redaction we require.

kevin: short version: product wants 90d retention for billing reconciliation. security wants aggressive redaction for tenant_id after 7d unless service is billing-authorized.

niya: policy note: GDPR/DP concerns if tenant_id is stored reversible. we prefer hashed+salted values and a short TTL. hosted tenants flagged as PII-sensitive should default to meta-only.

sam: practical compromise: store envelope.meta forever, store exact values for 7 days in hosted by default, then either delete or move to encrypted cold storage for 90d if the service is billing-authorized and owner approved.

kevin: agree but need audit controls. any move to cold storage must be recorded with `vault_audit_id` and a recorded owner approval in the ledger. also console UI should surface which services have extended retention.

policy-bot: suggestion: require a signed data retention exception for any retention >30d for hosted. automated check: if a service toggles billing-authorized, create GOV ticket.

niya: also define what "redaction" means: prefer tokenization (irreversible) for hosted PII. for billing needs, provide an inferred mapping record with confidence score instead of raw tenant_id.

leah: how about this policy: 1) envelope.meta retained 365d, 2) exact billing attrs retained 7d by default hosted, 3) services can request extension to 90d with signed exception and encrypted cold store, 4) private deployments unaffected.

sam: add: hashed buckets and sample metadata kept for sampled traces indefinitely (non-reversible hash + per-period salt). console will indicate whether attribution is exact, inferred, or hashed.

kevin: implementation notes: SDK emits `envelope.meta` + `envelope.provenance`. ingestion enforcer will drop exact values for hosted tenants after 7d unless ledger record exists. add automated job to migrate approved records to cold store.

niya: compliance asks: document how disputes are handled if tenant requests erasure. flow: remove exact values from live storage, mark migrated entries as deleted in ledger, re-run reconciliation without those values.

leah: action items: kevin -> infra flow + ledger schema (PR by Tue), sam -> console banner + UI copy for retention opt-in (mock by Wed), niya -> draft retention exception template for legal (due Fri). infra-bot: schedule canary to test enforcement.

infra-bot: canary scheduled for retention-enforcer v1 in staging (window: Thu 08:00-20:00).

kevin: I'll also add a telemetry metric `attr_retention_extensions` and an alert if >5 services request extension in a week.

leah: perfect. we'll put this into the RFC appendix under "privacy & retention policy" and circulate for final approval. thanks all :pray:
